Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

health — the condition of your body. Example: My health is good.
diet — the food you usually eat. Example: My diet has got fruit and vegetables.
exercise — physical activity that keeps you fit. Example: I do exercise every day.
sleep — to rest with your eyes closed at night. Example: I sleep eight hours.
water — the clear liquid we drink. Example: I drink a lot of water.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I sleep eight hours.
• I do exercise every day.
• I drink a lot of water.
• My diet is healthy.
• How do you stay healthy?
